rows.text: makes the call at `0031E860` + 0x4 and returns its null result unchanged; a non-null result is passed as `rcx` to the tail-jump at `0031E860` + 0x1A
sets `r8d` to 1 and tail-jumps at `00422E40` + 0x6 with `rcx` and `edx` unchanged

notes: 00422E40: the only interior instruction is the tail jmp; the r8d = 1 store is the entry instruction itself, so the one anchor covers the jump only.
